Class Editions

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Editions
public final class Editions extends Object
Which edition of each plugin is running, for plugins that come as a free and a Pro jar. A plugin registers its edition in setup() and unregisters in shutdown(); its /tempest tab starts with heading(String) and an admin who hits a free limit is told with limitReached(String, String). Only admins ever see these texts. 
Editions.register("Crates", isPro, List.of("pity counters", "Open x10"), licensedTo);
settings.add(Editions.heading("Crates"));
if (!isPro && crates.size() >= 5) { tell(Editions.limitReached("Crates", "5 crates")); return; }
Free limits only stop making more of something; what a server already has keeps working.
